  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The pending-request jq filter builds `$f` with `from_entries` from `k`/`v` pairs, so `$f.item` and `$f.fingerprint` are null and every request marker is dropped.
  WHY: The poller returns with nothing written, so `validation_harness_hold_requests_used` is never persisted and the CI tests fail with KeyError. Severity: sonnet BLOCKER, luna MAJOR, gemini gave no severity, so the highest (BLOCKER) is used. Confidence: sonnet gave 3, the others 5.

  WHY: The consumed request stays eligible and the used-once guarantee breaks. The reviewers did not pin the exact cause: it could be the pending filter, a rolled-back `post_state_comment`, or a later state write.

  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The dedup guard `index([$x])` searches the accumulator for a one-element array instead of `$x`, so it never deduplicates.
  WHY: qwen rated it BLOCKER and called it the root cause of the failing tests. glm rated it NIT and said the guard is currently dead code. Anthropic's reviewer said `index([$x])` is a valid subarray search and the claim is wrong. Severity disagreement: highest used (BLOCKER).

  WHY: The dashboard and alert state a raw status the project never had. gemini cited lines 15317-15320 for `vhq_cause`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15731-15751 | severity=low | confidence=5

- agents.d/validation-harness-routing-p2.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fragment says any future `since` is `since_invalid`, but the code (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15736) only rejects `since` more than 86400s ahead.
  WHY: The documented contract and the implementation disagree.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15921-15923 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The consumed-request ledger keeps only the last 50 ids, so older request comments become eligible again after more than 50 requests.
  WHY: This breaks the used-once requirement. luna rated it MAJOR. glm rated it NIT and called it a contract-precision defect that needs more than 50 requests.
